purpose: Focused repair of no-form effects omitted from selected cast. Text only; retained local records, no production reads or writes, no images.
authorization: Owner chose option A on 2026-10-23 after a quoted $0.05–0.15 evaluation increase. Apply the upper bound $0.15, raising evaluation to $16.95; this operation is capped at $0.12.
method: Paired v2/v3 reviews of each of the four retained defective final plans, three times each, interleaved baseline then candidate. Candidate-only reviews of three retained ordinary-light plans, three times each. Then one ordinary prepareMoment per verse per repeat over all seven retained verse/section/cast snapshots, each with a fresh memory store. Same production adapter, low reasoning for reviews, default planning sampling; no prompt tuning or reruns after seeing outcomes.

acceptance.review: Candidate catches God as unselected_figure on all 12 defective reviews and produces no God unselected_figure/outside_instant on the 9 ordinary-light controls. Other problems reported separately. No unavailable reviews.
acceptance.pipeline: All 21 runs must store an acceptable scene without an unselected no-form presence, an unsupported selected presence, or embodied no-form subjects. Refusals and unrelated flaws retained and reported separately; a refusal is not an accepted repair. Operator reads every stored plan against source and cast. No claim about population acceptance or image quality.

retryPolicy: One-shot run, ledger created exclusively. Only ordinary malformed-reply retry and one re-plan. Stop on provider failure, unknown cost, unexpected request, review unavailable or reserve limit. Do not start a unit without $0.012 headroom. Retain every call and first outcome.
audit: Freeze source hashes, fixture hashes and dry-run request hashes before paid calls. Offline verify replays all provider replies through reviewPlan/prepareMoment and compares outcomes and ledger. Retain operator scoring with exact plan quotes.
